title: RC4 Adverse Compression Resolution-State Audit
question: At the existing fixed eight-M30-bar RC4 management checkpoint, does the adverse vote state identify materially worse subsequent economics, and within adverse triggers is ordinary broker-applied 25%-retained-loss compression associated with materially better final 2x-cost stressed R and stop incidence than price-geometry refusal?
hypothesis: If the existing RC4 management state has economic information, adverse checkpoints should finish with lower stressed R and more stops than nonadverse checkpoints after direction-period adjustment. If successful compression has a realized containment signature, compressed adverse lifecycles should finish better and stop less often than refused adverse lifecycles, while compressed stop-outs remain materially inside the original planned-risk budget.
why_now: Unit 045 closed Program 2 invalid without a VIX-context verdict or seed. A fresh whole-map comparison selects Program 4 because its prior Unit 040 received no economic answer, while the current frozen baseline already emits a dense, causally ordered and outcome-free natural resolution state across every period. This is not a continuation of the rejected held-position later-signal proposal and creates no new exit threshold.

research_bundle.name: existing_rc4_checkpoint_and_adverse_resolution_states

variants.treatment: ADVERSE_COMPRESSED plus ADVERSE_REFUSED, fixed vote sum <= -2
variants.expected_effect: treatment-minus-comparator stressed R negative and stop rate positive

variants.comparator: ADVERSE_REFUSED, price-geometry refusal after the same adverse vote gate
variants.expected_effect: treatment-minus-comparator stressed R positive and stop rate negative

research_bundle.context_only: NO_CHECKPOINT lifecycles that close before a valid eight-bar checkpoint are reported but cannot pass or rescue either variant.

frozen_mechanism_semantics.checkpoint: Evaluate once after at least eight held US30 M30 bars.
frozen_mechanism_semantics.vote: Three ordinal heads in {-1,0,+1}; adverse trigger when vote sum <= -2.
frozen_mechanism_semantics.compression: Move the original stop to retain 25% of original loss-side distance when retained loss, tightening and quote clearance are each valid.
frozen_mechanism_semantics.compressed_event: ARC_COMPRESSED with broker_applied=1 and recovery=0 in the frozen evidence.
frozen_mechanism_semantics.refused_event: ARC_REFUSED when the ordinary retained-loss, tightening or quote-clearance geometry check fails.
frozen_mechanism_semantics.source_role: Read only to freeze meaning. No baseline or family source is copied, included, linked, changed or executed.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only RC4 OPEN direction, event ordering, ARC_CHECKPOINT vote, ARC_COMPRESSED/ARC_REFUSED resolution identity, close boundary and period were accessed. No close value, stressed R, stop association, role-conditioned economics or Unit 046 verdict was accessed.

execution_disclosure.discarded_display: A shorthand Where-Object tokenization error displayed zero checkpoints while the raw compressed/refused counts were 42/27. No economic field was accessed; all zero checkpoint derivatives were discarded.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary event key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, close-before-birth precedence, then source path and line.
fixed_reconstruction.birth: RC4 OPEN begins one lifecycle, supplies entry price, original stop and positive planned risk, and defines BUY when entry > stop otherwise SELL.
fixed_reconstruction.checkpoint: Attach the single ARC_CHECKPOINT vote while the lifecycle is active.
fixed_reconstruction.resolution: An adverse lifecycle must attach exactly one ARC_COMPRESSED or ARC_REFUSED event; nonadverse and no-checkpoint lifecycles attach neither.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the lifecycle. value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD; EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop-loss exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: value_b divided by positive birth planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.direction_period_centering: For each of eight BUY/SELL x P1-P4 cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and stop rate from every lifecycle before variant aggregation.

fixed_metrics.group_report: For every natural role report n, 2x stressed net, mean stressed R, stop rate, positive-rate and four period plus two direction centered summaries.
fixed_metrics.ADVERSE_VOTE_STATE: Mean centered stressed R and stop of all 69 adverse roles minus the corresponding means of 117 nonadverse checkpoint roles.
fixed_metrics.COMPRESSION_APPLIED_STATE: Mean centered stressed R and stop of 42 compressed roles minus the corresponding means of 27 refused roles.
fixed_metrics.compressed_stop_containment: Among compressed EXTERNAL_CLOSE lifecycles, report n, mean stressed R and share with stressed R >= -0.50R.
fixed_metrics.contribution_share: Absolute period effect numerator divided by the sum of absolute four-period effect numerators.

fixed_integrity_gate: Both pinned baseline source files and all six event files retain their exact byte lengths and hashes.
Retain 16,477 data rows with zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 206 RC4 lifecycles, BUY/SELL 108/98, 79.0680 USD 2x stressed net and 53 stop exits with zero overlap, risk, checkpoint, resolution or close fault.
Reconstruct exact natural roles 20/117/42/27/0 and their frozen period and direction counts.
Reconstruct exactly eight nonempty direction-period centering cells.

density: Adverse n is exactly 69 and nonadverse n exactly 117.
Adverse has at least 13 and nonadverse at least 15 lifecycles in every period.
Both roles contain at least 25 BUY and 25 SELL lifecycles.
information: Adverse-minus-nonadverse centered stressed R is at most -0.10R.
Adverse-minus-nonadverse centered stop rate is at least +0.10.
Return and stop effects have the expected signs in at least three of four periods.
Return and stop effects have the expected signs in both BUY and SELL.
No one period contributes more than 60% of the absolute centered-R effect numerator.

density: Compressed n is exactly 42 and refused n exactly 27.
Compressed has at least seven lifecycles in every period; refused has at least three in every period and at least five in three periods.
Both roles contain at least 13 BUY and 13 SELL lifecycles.
information: Compressed-minus-refused centered stressed R is at least +0.10R.
Compressed-minus-refused centered stop rate is at most -0.10.
Return and stop effects have the expected signs in at least three of four periods.
Return and stop effects have the expected signs in both BUY and SELL.
No one period contributes more than 60% of the absolute centered-R effect numerator.
At least five compressed lifecycles stop out, their mean stressed R is at least -0.40R, and at least 75% finish no worse than -0.50R.

fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every listed density and information requirement passes.

fixed_bundle_gate.success: Both variants pass every gate, establishing an existing-state risk-containment signature only.
fixed_bundle_gate.partial: Exactly one variant passes; record which state is informative but retain no successor.
fixed_bundle_gate.failure: Neither variant passes; retain no successor.
fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: No outcome can prove causal benefit because compression versus refusal is not randomized and no uncompressed counterfactual exists.
fixed_bundle_gate.passing_action: Close as a bounded diagnosis. Do not change or remove RC4 management, propagate it to another strategy, tune its checkpoint/vote/fraction/geometry, create an EA candidate or open a successor automatically.

verdict_rules.success: PASS_EXISTING_RC4_COMPRESSION_RESOLUTION_SIGNATURE_DIAGNOSIS when integrity and both variants pass.
verdict_rules.partial: PARTIAL_RC4_MANAGEMENT_STATE_DIAGNOSIS_NO_SUCCESSOR when integrity passes and exactly one variant passes.
verdict_rules.failure: NO_RC4_COMPRESSION_RESOLUTION_STATE_PASSED when integrity passes and neither variant passes.
verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_RC4_STATE_OR_LIFECYCLE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_MANAGEMENT_VERDICT when any source, input, lifecycle, role or anchor integrity check fails.
verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_RC4_STATE_DIAGNOSIS_NO_SUCCESSOR only if integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition prevents exact application without changing the contract.

Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six immutable event files.
Do not alter checkpoint bars, vote thresholds, retained-loss fraction, role definitions, centering, metrics or gates.
Do not inspect modify failures, recovery or broker safety, modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
